title: Bound fixed-paid productive endpoint exchanges on #7481
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact [#7481](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7481) at `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b`, two exact enumerators agree on all 60,806 coframed two-role ADD/SCALE windows. Eight had positive relaxed productive price. All eight exact actions are single shears. Zero eligible cases remain unresolved. The exact 400-role caller set excludes all nine initial swap regression windows from eligible endpoint changes.

At chart 1049 before ADD36481, the cycle on 1322, 1352 and 1440 would change productive ranks (9,5,2) to (5,7,4), with gross about 0.12252572644 raw. Two exact prefix inputs kill all three live rows and distinguish the required contrasts. Independently, the suffix has an outside-output minor of determinant −73767/4096. Preserving those outputs leaves at most one carrier direction, while the cycle needs two. The paid itinerary and κ are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Refine the fixed-paid productive endpoint exchange family on canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` with the signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7391](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7391) uses the same fixed-paid exchange identity on the role-1481 pair on #7334. This package covers literal two-role scalar windows and one named three-role cycle on #7481. The two separate prerequisite commits reuse the shared [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI fixes. The scientific package has 24 files.

## Validation

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12, run:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-fixed-paid-productive-endpoint-exchanges/replay.py
```

The wrapper authenticates exact inputs, regenerates the full window IDs, checks all eight matrices and five receipts, and rejects corrupted data. Direct and registered local replay, commit bytes/modes and source-history checks, read-only Git-free export replay and 27 onboarding tests passed on the identical package tree. The physical and full multiplier checks were not run because no edit survived the necessary gates.

## Credit

[#7391](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7391) supplies the fixed-paid suffix exchange and prefix-span proof. [#7395](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7395) and [#7408](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7408) study wider banks for its original pair. #7481/#7480/#7334 supply the native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, and #7482/#7298 the exact coefficient and price tools. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

## Open next questions

Other cuts, wider banks and changed itineraries remain open. For a different strictly nested cycle, require a positive directed price and the exact prefix contrast span before a build. Review and merge remain with the maintainers.
